Measure boundary

Academic year 2025 · U3284001 ↗

SED counts research doctorate recipients on confirmed graduation lists submitted by U. Delaware for the academic year. They are completions, not current enrollment or alumni employment records. Beginning in 2021, SED adopted a modified 2020 CIP-based field taxonomy. Field-level values before and after that change require care; the all-fields series remains visible with the source note.
